newest_result.claim_status: corrected finite-field incidence, determinant-948 Shimura identification, exact seven-edge public Kneser-chain replay, and three audited bounded target-to-endpoint searches with no exact bridge
newest_result.limitation: This K3 route has produced no P3, rational lift, characteristic-zero target triple, explicit geometric neighbor/moduli map, or rank-32 curve. The zero-triple result is bounded to GF(5), GF(7), GF(11), GF(13), the certified dense and intrinsic boundary charts, and the Kodaira open; the larger-prime first stage is sampled. The lattice searches are not complete p=2-neighbor enumerations: the earlier run rejected two vectors and the endpoint-balanced run rejected four at Sage's non-maximal/even boundary. Each negative scope is restricted to successfully constructed recorded moves.

New offset-32 run 34161893470 was also source-audited: 7,872 successful moves, zero construction failures, 32 negative exact qfisom comparisons at common profile (40,2570), no bridge.
newest_result.name: two-split E8+A2^3 incidence, exact rank-17 neighbor replay, and bounded X(6,79) endpoint search
newest_result.statement: The corrected dense and intrinsic-boundary searches contain 30 exact total-intersection-two P1/P2 pairs in 71,302,414 section tests. Exhausting 9,456,854 subsequent P3 candidates found no complete Gram triple. A sampled pair-first extension at p=17,19,23 performed 88,931,043 further section tests and exhaustively checked 5,315,813 P3 candidates after its three eligible pairs, again with zero P3. The full incidence reduces to a 61-by-62 Jacobian and six P3 remainder equations. Independently, the target essential lattice has the same cyclic discriminant form and X(6,79) Clifford fingerprint as the determinant-948 Shimura landscape. Actions run 32673843229 exactly replayed the seven public Kneser steps and all rational parent-child Gram identities, including the composed basis identity. Run 32674002260 serialized 4,990 successful moves among 4,992 attempted lines and found no common cross-side theta fingerprint or exact bridge.
